identity.title: ALMA 0.1-0.2 arcsec Resolution Imaging of the NGC 1068 Nucleus: Compact Dense Molecular Gas Emission at the Putative AGN Location

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present the results of our ALMA Cycle 2 high angular resolution (0$\ensuremath{''}$1–0$\ensuremath{''}$2) observations of the nuclear region of the nearby well-studied type-2 active galactic nucleus (AGN), NGC 1068

question.value: Can compact dense molecular gas emission (HCN and HCO+ J=3-2) from the putative dusty torus at the AGN location in NGC 1068 be separated from the brighter eastern and western knots at 0.1-0.2 arcsec resolution, and what are its properties?

evidence.quote: Molecular gas observation with even higher angular resolution may better reveal the molecular emission arising from the dusty molecular torus.
